recorded.prompt:q-compromise: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-compromise: This is the same case as the page's A (10,1), B (1,10), C (5,5). C is Pareto optimal ('C beats A on the second and B on the first'), yet 'C never wins... C is the compromise many planners would choose, and it is unsupported.' Here max(1+8s, 9-8s) >= 5 > 4.
recorded.prompt:q-proof: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-proof: 'Every point strictly below such a segment, with an NPV strictly between the two ends, fails the two inequalities in the same way.' The a-b line at 20 is at 30, and q is at 25, below it.
recorded.prompt:q-relaxation: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-relaxation: 'Any average of two feasible LP solutions is feasible (the constraints are linear)... every Pareto-optimal point of a multi-objective LP is supported.'

recorded.prompt:q-compromise:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compromise:a: Dominance means 'at least as good in every objective'. (4,4) beats (9,1) on the second measure and (1,9) on the first, like C, which is 'dominated by nothing'. A higher total is not dominance.
recorded.prompt:q-compromise:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compromise:b: At share 0.5 the page's table picks A (A and B tie at 5.5, C scores 5). 'C never wins, and not because the grid is coarse'.
recorded.prompt:q-compromise:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-compromise:d: 'C is the compromise many planners would choose, and it is unsupported.' Not every Pareto-optimal plan is supported.
recorded.prompt:q-proof:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-proof:b: q is not halfway on the segment: the segment point at 20 is (20,30) and q is below it. The same passage rules out every share.
recorded.prompt:q-proof:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-proof:c: The planners' plan is dominated by nothing, yet 'there is no price at which this plan is the best one'. Nondominance does not imply support.
recorded.prompt:q-proof:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-proof:d: Weights (1,0) 'ask only for the most NPV', and b has more of the first measure (30 > 20). The segment passage also excludes every s in [0,1].
recorded.prompt:q-relaxation:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-relaxation:a: 'every Pareto-optimal point of a multi-objective LP is supported' and the section heading 'an LP Has None'.
recorded.prompt:q-relaxation:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-relaxation:b: 'Integer variables create unsupported points; an LP has none.' The relaxation removes them even though the objectives are the same.
recorded.prompt:q-relaxation:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-relaxation:c: 'the set of reachable (N, R) values is convex, no point can sit below the segment between two others'. The LP has none, not some.
